summary: Kong API Gateway 3.16 adds OpenMeter-powered request-time entitlement enforcement for usage limits and feature access, strengthening Kong's monetization and enterprise-operations story. The current 3.16 documentation explicitly says credit-balance enforcement is not yet implemented, correcting the release blog's broader prepaid-credit wording. No adoption or financial impact was disclosed, so the thesis remains MAINTAIN at 69/100 and model inputs are unchanged. No new IPO filing, financing, verified secondary transaction, acquisition, executive change, or company financial disclosure surfaced.
